name: comp-459
title: Pagination With Ellipsis
blurb: Pagination with ellipsis for page range skipping.
description: Pagination displaying page numbers with ellipsis (...) indicating skipped page ranges.
use_when: Large result sets where showing all page numbers would be impractical.
avoid_when: Pagination with few pages or when compact display is not needed.
a11y: Semantic pagination with clickable page numbers and ellipsis indicating skipped pages.
